{{Quote|At the center of Vianism is a mother goddess, Via in the Argazdan tongue, with two other entities representing aspects of the goddess: the Beatific Countenance and the Glorious Radiance.|Tash Arranda, ''Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd, Or: What I Did On My Inter-Term Break''|<ref name="Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20090531/index.html?page=1|text=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd: A Hyperspace Exclusive|int=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd}}</ref>}}
The '''Beatific Countenance''' was one of two aspects of the [[God/Legends|goddess]] [[Via]], worshipped by followers of [[Vianism]]. The other aspect was [[Glorious Radiance]].<ref name="Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd" />
